pre_reactor_steps: Degas acetonitrile solvent via sparging with inert gas (N2/Ar) to remove dissolved oxygen, although reaction is not O2 sensitive, to prevent potential side reactions or catalyst deactivation over long residence times.
post_reactor_steps: Filter reaction mixture through a 0.45 micron PTFE filter to remove N-doped carbon heterogeneous catalyst.
proposal.chemistry_notes: Knoevenagel condensation using heterogeneous N-doped carbon catalyst. Batch time is 24h, but flow allows for intensified conditions. Engineering calculations suggest a 10x intensification factor (IF) is reasonable for this class, reducing residence time to 144 min. A packed bed reactor is required to handle the solid catalyst. The long residence time (144 min) necessitates a large reactor volume (72 mL) or very low flow rates. To maintain practical flow rates (0.5 mL/min), a long coil or multiple packed bed cartridges are needed. Temperature is maintained at 50 C as per batch. No BPR required as T < bp - 20C.

case.title: Knoevenagel condensation over N-doped carbon
case.protocol: Benzaldehyde (5.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and malononitrile (5.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) were combined with an N-doped carbon heterogeneous basic catalyst in acetonitrile. The suspension was heated at 50 C for 24 h in a 25 mL round-bottom flask. The 2-benzylidenemalononitrile product was obtained in 85% yield.
